categories.label: Ontological relationships
categories.description: Being, existence, constitution, and relationships between entities or processes.

categories.label: Dialectical and process relationships
categories.description: Dialectical naturalism, critical theory, Hegelian philosophy, and process philosophy.

categories.label: Logical and argumentative relationships
categories.description: Connect propositions or arguments, rather than concepts.

categories.label: Epistemological relationships
categories.description: Knowledge, justification, evidence, interpretation, and uncertainty.

categories.label: Ethical and political relationships
categories.description: Normative claims, relations of power, and relationships between practices and ethical ends.

categories.label: Conceptual and semantic relationships
categories.description: Distinguish concept identity from the terminology used to name it.

categories.label: Genealogical and historical relationships
categories.description: Connect concepts, texts, theories, and formulations through intellectual history.

categories.label: Methodological and practical relationships
categories.description: Connect philosophical commitments to research, design, and practice.

categories.label: Logical operators
categories.description: Statement connectives and reasoning markers in ordinary wording. Truth-functional entries use classical two-valued semantics; consequence/derivability and therefore/because are separately labelled claims, not automatic proofs.

categories.label: Rhetorical and discourse relationships
categories.description: Connections between discourse units, their presentation and communicative roles.

categories.label: Temporal relationships
categories.description: Ordering and interval relations, with explicit boundary conditions and no automatic causal implication.

categories.label: Source and provenance relationships
categories.description: Claims about entities, source material, revisions, agents and generating activities; distinct from authoritative application history.

categories.label: Causal and empirical relationships
categories.description: Contextual causal claims, outcome changes and statistical association; not automatic inference or proof.
